name: Prism Zenith
core_rationale: Central observatory town of The Eclipse Observatory at [1, 1] built beneath rotating quartz lens-rings where astronomers calibrate Vesper's starlight beacons and guard the Pendulum Sanctum.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Refracted rainbow star-pools circulating through carved quartz channels around the central telescope

North.lock_message: Unfocused solar-eclipse rays at Apogee Lens Spire burn through unshielded gliders; the Zenith Astronomers require the Sanctum Prism-Gyro before opening the northern stair.

resident_npcs.name: Chief Astronomer Veyla
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Step up to the 0.60 meter eyepiece bench, young Sprout! Through these quartz lenses you can see every floating island in the Shattered Halo.

resident_npcs.name: Prism-Artisan Kael
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: With the Sanctum Prism-Gyro aligned, the eastern coral causeway to Kelp Spiral Reef in Nebula Undertide is now open!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors The Eclipse Observatory at [1, 1] where Vesper's astrolabe lenses focus starlight across Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating basalt observatory dome ringed by rotating quartz lenses and rainbow star-pools.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Eyepiece counters at 0.58 to 0.60m, stair risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.20m x 1.65m, and 13.5m observatory plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-orrery-bridge, East portal to hunting-area-kelp-spiral-reef, Dungeon portal to dungeon-pendulum-sanctum, and North fog_of_lore portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Apogee Lens Spire gate with a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Zenith Astronomers lock message.
